identifier_namespaces.format: five ASCII digits stored as a string, preserving leading zeros
identifier_namespaces.geometry_rule: Post-office/locality assignment does not imply an area or a point. Use independently permitted source geometry and explicit postal crosswalk; otherwise none.
GN, DS, district, province and census codes stay in their own namespace; neither containment nor similar digits create a postal assignment.

authority_model.rule: Postal assignment, independent geometry, administration, civic number, building relation and AGID cell evidence remain separate. Unknown validity remains null, not inferred from a page date.

stages.definition: Existing Sri Lanka address format and primary-source discovery only.
Reviewed LK namespace, privacy, geometry and publication contract with reproducible reference-only checks.

Current rights-cleared Sri Lanka Post or legally authorised five-digit string assignments, with declared post-office/locality scope and temporal validity, are joined to independently licensed source-linked point, route or area geometry (or explicit none without a spatial lookup claim). Reproducible coverage, exception, CRS/topology and privacy checks must validate real scoped records and approved immutable digest-pinned artifacts through the actual AGID loader/API. Preserve Sinhala, Tamil and English names, leading zeros, separate GN/DS/census identifiers and official/derived/virtual/none authority; exact civic/building display needs an independent explicit permitted relation.
Independent holdout, multilingual ambiguity, coverage, exceptions and civic/building relation checks pass within the declared release scope.
Repeated refresh, corrections, monitored freshness and verified rollback under reviewed rights.

agid_integration.current_scope: LK source catalog and address-format metadata only; LK is not enabled in the generic Postal Context runtime.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Enable LK only after a real scoped pack, reviewed rights and immutable release pass actual loader/API checks; source names, URLs or successful reference probes alone cannot validate addresses.
agid_integration.agid_cell_rule: An AGID cell is a spatial index, not a postal assignment or building identity.
